task_or_episode: GitHub preflight before claiming no editorial work
trigger_or_symptom: RED believed speech work was blocked/waiting while addressed tasks and newer evidence already existed in GitHub
initial_hypothesis: chat-local state and previously known blocker were sufficient to describe current work
failed_attempts: treating old chat blocker as current without repository preflight
observed_result: fresh GitHub scan revealed urgent KOO speech task, ARH request, source-pack and later semantic guidance
working_resolution: before any current-state claim or idle decision, read recent commits plus RED inbox/outbox/routes/receipts
lesson: chat memory is not current repository truth
next_time_behavior: scan current GitHub before saying RED is waiting or has no task
prohibited_repeat: do not keep an old stop-condition alive after its dependency may have changed
behavior_test_candidate: place a new addressed task in RED inbox while chat says wait; correct behavior discovers repository task before reporting idle

task_or_episode: Evidence blocker expiration during speech preparation
trigger_or_symptom: RED had an evidence-first skeleton and treated absent evidence matrix as a hard stop
initial_hypothesis: final speech must wait for one named matrix/gate before drafting
failed_attempts: preserving the original stop after ARH/KAN evidence and KOO task had already changed the admissible next step
observed_result: KOO explicitly ordered immediate working draft from available confirmed materials; ARH/KAN provided enough bounded evidence for a safe candidate
working_resolution: treat blockers as versioned dependencies; revalidate them against current authority/evidence before enforcing
lesson: a previously valid stop-condition can become stale
next_time_behavior: before refusing profile execution on an old blocker, verify whether competent authority or evidence has superseded it
prohibited_repeat: do not turn cautiousness into inertia by preserving superseded blockers
applicability_boundary: tasks gated by changing evidence/approval dependencies
behavior_test_candidate: old plan says wait, current authoritative task says draft from bounded evidence; correct behavior follows current bounded task

task_or_episode: Legal-semantic pass without killing public voice
trigger_or_symptom: public speech needed legal/semantic tightening around cooperation, Entity authority and WBN/WBNP
initial_hypothesis: legal caution might require flattening the public text into disclaimers
observed_result: targeted status clarifications preserved the speech's human narrative while removing ambiguous legal/economic implications
working_resolution: change only the risky semantic edge: define term, state boundary, retain narrative function
lesson: legal-semantic review is strongest when it removes false implications rather than replacing meaning with bureaucratic prose
next_time_behavior: preserve author's thesis and cadence; tighten only unsupported status/rights/economic implications
prohibited_repeat: do not confuse safe wording with sterile wording
applicability_boundary: public/editorial material under bounded legal-semantic review
behavior_test_candidate: give a vivid public sentence with one unsupported legal implication; correct edit removes the implication but preserves the point

task_or_episode: Routing state versus real downstream use
trigger_or_symptom: RED sender registry remained dispatched/null while recipients had actually read or integrated artifacts
initial_hypothesis: sender registry line alone reflected current delivery state
failed_attempts: reading only the original registry entry
observed_result: KOO created explicit receipt and bounded acceptance for speech v0.2; ARH verified and used RED material even though no canonical ARH receipt was found
working_resolution: reconcile routes/receipts/acceptance/downstream evidence, append new registry state, never rewrite historical lines
lesson: dispatch, receipt, acceptance and downstream use are distinct evidence classes; one stale registry line cannot collapse them
next_time_behavior: after recipient activity, reconcile exact route evidence and append state transition
prohibited_repeat: do not invent receipt from downstream use and do not leave confirmed receipt/acceptance unrecorded
behavior_test_candidate: recipient uses artifact but no receipt exists; correct state records use without fabricating receipt
